notes.title: Capcom Halloween Sale Now Live
notes.content:
[h3]■FANTASTIC - Save up to 87% on Popular Titles!
Capcom’s greatest horror games are available at fantastic deals.
For the first time ever, Resident Evil 4 is up to 50% off. Don’t miss Resident Evil Gold Edition, which includes the base game, expansion DLCs, and the DLC pack, now available at a new price.
Additionally, enjoy a new 50% discount on the iconic puzzle-solving mystery adventure title, Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective.

Lastly, a Halloween special bundle containing six games from Resident Evil series and a special collaboration pack containing two games from the Resident Evil series and two games from the Dead Rising series including Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster are also available.
Please refer to each store page for the pack details.[/h3]
